lead: A `Core` callback whose result the member discards returns `mixed`, never `void`.
body: `void` is what the row means and it refuses every `fn (): int` body a program may reasonably write, where `Ty::Void` *is* assignable to `mixed` in return position — so `mixed` takes a `fn (): void` body and a value-returning one alike, and still constrains the parameters. Write `CoreTy::Mixed` at any callback the member does not read back, and a concrete return only where it uses the answer.
